name: mdv-second-brain
description: Persistent project memory for coding agents, kept as an Obsidian vault per workspace: the agent records what was done, why and what was learned (Kanban board with living task and issue notes, daily session state, distilled project knowledge), with strict workspace isolation.

interface.shortDescription: Persistent project memory for coding agents, in an Obsidian vault
interface.longDescription: Persistent project memory for Codex and Claude, kept as an Obsidian vault per workspace and written by the agent: a Kanban board whose cards link to living task and issue notes, a daily note with the state of every session, distilled project knowledge, ideas, decisions and post mortems. The next session starts from where the last one stopped. Inert outside a workspace until you activate it.
